profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Otter.ai
profile.summary:
Frontend-focused engineer comfortable working across the stack. Experienced in building and maintaining user-facing, responsive, and performant web and mobile applications. Brings a strong understanding of computer science fundamentals and a love for creating high quality products to frontend development.

“Move fast and don’t break things.”

Currently working with Next.js, React, React Native, and TypeScript.

positions.title: Frontend Engineer
positions.locationName: South San Francisco, California, United States
positions.description: Built the frontend for Bright Pattern's mobile and web apps for contact centers using React Native, React, and Typescript.

positions.title: MSI Tutor
positions.description: Tutored groups of students in the Introduction to Algorithm Analysis course (CMPS102) at UCSC. Taught and discussed concepts such as recursion, divide and conquer, greedy algorithms, dynamic programming, graph algorithms, data structures, and run-time analysis. Also tutored for Computer Systems and Assembly Language (CMPE12).

positions.title: Grader
positions.description: Grader for CMPS109, Advanced Programming. Tested students’ programs with test scripts, reviewed their code, and assigned grades.
